主要内容: The document is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, which is a report of a foreign private issuer under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. The filing includes information about the issuance of Senior Global Medium-Term Notes, Series F, by the Bank. The Notes include $1,500,000,000 aggregate principal amount of 1.200% Senior Notes, due January 23, 2017, and $1,000,000,000 aggregate principal amount of Senior Floating Rate Notes, due January 23, 2017. The filing includes various exhibits, such as opinions from legal counsel regarding the validity of the Notes and tax matters. The report was signed by James Salem, Executive Vice-President and Treasurer of Royal Bank of Canada, on January 23, 2014.
